name: ai-shuffle
description: AI Shuffle is a free, open-source workspace for running AI agents on your own server. Sign in with the AI account you already have (Claude, ChatGPT or SuperGrok subscriptions, or API keys for Claude, OpenAI, OpenRouter, xAI and local models) and put agents to work: writing code, running scheduled jobs, answering messages and handling chores across your machines. Check in from your phone with the Android app, or connect your desktop and laptop as extra workers. Everything runs on your hardware. Your provider bills you directly; AI Shuffle adds no markup and never sees your prompts. The database (a private PostgreSQL) is built in, so there is nothing else to install. First start takes a few minutes. Open the WebUI and create the owner password, or set Owner Password below before the first start. Anyone who can reach this port on your network can try to sign in, so do not forward it from your router. For access away from home, use a VPN such as Tailscale or WireGuard. The extra parameters give the container a clean 90-second shutdown, enough shared memory for the built-in browser, and the permissions the sandbox around agents' Python code needs. Remove the three --security-opt flags to opt out of that sandbox.

paths.name: Workspace
paths.description: Your projects, as ordinary files you can open from a share. Point this at a share if you want to browse them over the network.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Database, encryption key, chats and saved credentials. Back up this folder (with the container stopped) together with the others below.

paths.name: Claude Code sign-in
paths.description: Sign-in and settings for the Claude Code CLI, if you use a Claude subscription.

paths.name: CLI programs
paths.description: Provider CLI programs installed on demand, such as Claude Code, kept across updates.

paths.name: Browser profile
paths.description: The built-in browser's profile, so sites you sign in to stay signed in.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the web interface and API.

variables.name: Owner Password
variables.description: Optional. Sets the sign-in password on the first start only (at least 12 characters). Leave empty to create it in the browser on your first visit. Change it later in Settings, Security.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns your project files. 99 (nobody) is the Unraid default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns your project files. 100 (users) is the Unraid default.

variables.name: Secure cookies
variables.description: Keep false for plain http:// on your LAN. Set true only when you reach AI Shuffle through HTTPS (a reverse proxy or Tailscale Serve).

variables.name: Trusted proxies
variables.description: Optional. The address of your reverse proxy as the container sees it, for example 172.17.0.1. Never list your whole network.

variables.name: Agent isolation
variables.description: off, on or required. on keeps agents' shells away from AI Shuffle's own database password and keys. Back up first; see the install guide.
